title: Patch: the AI prices the Start of turn and End of turn effects of Units on the board, on both sides

**Issue #2565 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2565: Patch: the AI prices the Start of turn and End of turn effects of Units on the board, on both sides
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some Units do something at the start or end of every turn. One grows and hits the enemy hero each turn; another hands its owner a card every turn. Since the last AI patch, the computer opponent counts this for its own backrow cards, but not for Units on the board, whether its own or the other player's. So it leaves a growing enemy engine alone to hit a plain body of the same size, and trades its own engines away as if they were blank. After this change, the AI counts one turn of such a Unit's effect on both sides of the board.

## Why
- R2477000's "What is not priced" list names "A unit's turn hooks" (`spec/rulings/R2477000.md:16`). It also leaves "probing the enemy's face-up Field Spells too, left for a later issue" (`:20`).
- `turn_hook_prices` keeps only backrow holders, `.filter(|holder| holder.zone == TriggerZone::Backrow)` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1354`). The price is added only on the AI's own side, `if player == seat` (`evaluate.rs:724`).
- Real cards affected:
  - Gatling Pea (`crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c013_gatling_pea.rs`): "End of turn: Deal {damage} damage to the enemy hero. Then this damage permanently goes up by {growth}."
  - Gravedigger (`core/c037_gravedigger.rs`): "Start of turn: add a random card from your GY to your hand".
- `training/improve.md:100-101` names this as the loss the AI's training notes trace again and again: "an engine, a unit that grows or makes value every turn, priced at its body today and left unanswered".
- The learned weights (`crates/ai/src/learned/weights.json`, catalog v0.3.17) know none of the newer sets' cards, so the hand evaluation's price is the only one for them.

## Proposal
- Let `turn_hook_prices` probe field holders as well as backrow ones. Spawn hand Units into the sandbox first, as the Death probes do.
- Price the enemy's face-up holders from the enemy's view, on the enemy's own hook (its Start and End of turn).
- Add the `turn_hook` share of the price inside `unit_worth`, so a Unit's worth carries it wherever it is counted.
- Raise or split `AI_TURN_HOOK_PROBE_NODES` as measured.
- A new ruling in the issue's block amends R2477000's "What is not priced".

## Where it lands
`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`, and `spec/rulings/R<n>.md` with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md` (§9.9).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given one removal and two targets, an enemy Gatling Pea and an enemy vanilla Unit with equal or slightly better stats, the AI removes the Gatling Pea.
- [ ] With its own Gravedigger and a same-cost vanilla Unit on the board, the AI trades the vanilla first.
- [ ] Hidden cards are never probed (R185), and a hook that harms its holder prices below zero, as R2477000's do.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size, and the perf gate's decision time holds.

## Size and risks
Medium, and hard (AI). More probes per decision, bounded by the node constant. The Hard-vs-Easy gate must still pass, so the weight may need screening. Practice fixtures that pin the AI's moves may need re-recording.

6. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`:
   - In `unit_worth` (lines 370-373), add `+ w.turn_hook * turn_hook_price(state, unit, w)` after the `w.death * death_price(state, unit, w)` term.
   - In `material` (lines 729-733), remove the `if player == seat` check enclosing `value += w.turn_hook * turn_hook_price(state, card, w);`, so that any card matching `readable_by(state, card, seat)` receives its `turn_hook_price`.
   - In `turn_hook_probe` (lines 1293-1312):
     - Change signature to: `fn turn_hook_probe(before: &GameState, owner: PlayerId, instance_id: &str, counter: &dyn NodeCounter) -> Option<Option<f64>>`.
     - In the loop over `TURN_HOOKS`, call `trigger_holders_with_hook(before, hook, Some(owner))` and filter with `(holder.zone == TriggerZone::Backrow || holder.zone == TriggerZone::Field) && holder.card.id == instance_id`.
   - In `spawned_turn_hook_probe` (lines 1317-1342):
     - Inspect `card_type_of_face(world, &card.def_id, card.radiant)`.
     - For `CardType::Unit`: find or create an open slot in `Row::Units` (clearing a single-card pile if full, matching the pattern in `spawned_death_probe`), spawn to `Row::Units` at `slot.lane`, and call `turn_hook_probe(&placed, seat, &placed_card.id, counter)`.
     - For `CardType::FieldSpell`: spawn to `Row::Backrow` at `first_entry_zone(world, seat, Row::Backrow)` and call `turn_hook_probe(&placed, seat, &placed_card.id, counter)`.
     - Return `Some(None)` if no slot can be made or if the card type is neither.
   - In `turn_hook_prices` (lines 1354-1405):
     - Collect own board holders from `trigger_holders_with_hook(world, hook, Some(seat))` where `holder.zone == TriggerZone::Field || holder.zone == TriggerZone::Backrow`.
     - Collect enemy board holders from `trigger_holders_with_hook(world, hook, Some(seat.opponent()))` where `holder.zone == TriggerZone::Field || (holder.zone == TriggerZone::Backrow && readable_by(world, &holder.card, seat))`.
     - Collect hand candidates from `world.players[seat].hand` where card type is `CardType::Unit` or `CardType::FieldSpell` and `has_turn_hook(world, card)`.
     - Build `candidates: Vec<(TurnHookPrice, CardInstance, bool)>`, deduplicating using `!candidates.iter().any(|(key, _, _)| key.is_for(&card))`.
     - Probe each candidate with sub-counter `AI_TURN_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`: for `in_hand`, call `spawned_turn_hook_probe(&sandbox, seat, card, &probes)`; for board holders, call `turn_hook_probe(&sandbox, card.controller, &card.id, &probes)`.
7. In `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`, update the comment above lines 424-425 to cite R2565000 alongside R2424000 and R2477000.
8. In `crates/ai/README.md`, update lines 18-20 and 86-90 to document board units and enemy face-up Field Spells priced under R2565000.
9. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs`:
   - Update `r2477000_an_enemy_face_down_card_is_priced_as_before`: remove `MANA_WELL` from the enemy backrow in that test (leaving only `ACE_IN_THE_HOLE`, which is a face-down trap) so it tests that hidden face-down enemy cards are never probed or priced.
   - Add test `r2565000_the_ai_removes_gatling_pea_over_a_vanilla_unit_of_equal_or_better_stats`: setup scenario with Hit Job (`core-016`) in AI hand and 2 mana, and enemy board with Gatling Pea (`meditative-013`, 2/6, Armor 2) and a vanilla unit (e.g. 2/8 or 3/7). Verify `decide` targets Gatling Pea.
   - Add test `r2565000_with_own_gravedigger_and_same_cost_vanilla_ai_trades_vanilla_first`: setup scenario with own Gravedigger (`core-037`) and a same-cost vanilla unit on board with cards in graveyard, against an enemy Taunt unit. Verify `decide` attacks with the vanilla unit first.
   - Add test `r2565000_enemy_face_up_field_spell_is_priced`: verify an enemy face-up Mana Well (`core-006`) in enemy backrow is probed and priced, while an enemy face-down Ace in the Hole (`classic-065`) is not.
   - Add test `r2565000_hand_unit_with_turn_hook_is_priced_by_spawning_first`: verify a hand Unit with turn hook (e.g. Gatling Pea) is priced with `used == 2` (spawn and firing).
   - Add test `r2565000_a_turn_hook_that_harms_its_holder_prices_below_zero`: verify a unit with self-damage at end of turn (e.g. `stinkyscape-t-meltdown-layer`) prices below zero.

4. **Tests.**
- File: `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs`
  - `r2477000_an_enemy_face_down_card_is_priced_as_before`: asserts enemy face-down trap is not probed (`(vec![], 0)`) and evaluation matches unheld evaluation.
  - `r2565000_the_ai_removes_gatling_pea_over_a_vanilla_unit_of_equal_or_better_stats`: asserts `decision.action` targets Gatling Pea with Hit Job.
  - `r2565000_with_own_gravedigger_and_same_cost_vanilla_ai_trades_vanilla_first`: asserts `decision.action` attacks with the vanilla unit instead of Gravedigger.
  - `r2565000_enemy_face_up_field_spell_is_priced`: asserts `price_of(&prices, MANA_WELL, false)` is priced for enemy face-up Field Spell while trap is unprobed.
  - `r2565000_hand_unit_with_turn_hook_is_priced_by_spawning_first`: asserts hand Gatling Pea prices with `used == 2`.
  - `r2565000_a_turn_hook_that_harms_its_holder_prices_below_zero`: asserts `price_of(&prices, "stinkyscape-t-meltdown-layer", false) < 0.0`.
  Commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai turn_hooks`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`

5. **Done when.**
- [ ] `spec/rulings/R2565000.md` created with frontmatter and full ruling text.
- [ ] `spec/pending/2565.md` created with §11 paragraph citing [[R2565000]].
- [ ] `spec/rulings/R2477000.md` and `spec/09-architecture.md` updated with [[R2565000]] citations.
- [ ] `AI_TURN_HOOK_PROBE_NODES` set to 24 in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.
- [ ] `unit_worth`, `material`, `turn_hook_probe`, `spawned_turn_hook_probe`, and `turn_hook_prices` updated in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`.
- [ ] Comments in `decide.rs` and docs in `crates/ai/README.md` updated.
- [ ] All turn hook unit tests pass (`cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai turn_hooks`).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes with no dangling references or unregistered rulings.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes cleanly.
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes cleanly.

6. **Risks.**
- **Hidden information leak (R185):** Probing enemy backrow could leak face-down trap identities if not filtered. Avoided by explicitly requiring `readable_by(world, &holder.card, seat)` which verifies `backrow_is_public` (only face-up cards or controller's own).
- **Node budget blowout (R186):** Probing both fields could exhaust search node budgets. Avoided by bounding sub-counter to `AI_TURN_HOOK_PROBE_NODES = 24`, deduplicating candidates by `(def_id, radiant)`, and breaking as soon as the sub-counter is exhausted.
- **Side effects during probing (rule 4):** Hook firings must not leak state modifications or thread-local price states. Avoided by running in a sandbox clone with `with_pool_hold` and resetting thread-locals with `with_turn_hook_prices(Vec::new(), ...)`.

7. **Open questions.**
None. All requirements, card scripts, pricing formulas, and ruling block numbers are fully specified.
````
